name: leads_campaign
summary: A LARGE lead list built over days or weeks (hundreds to tens of thousands of people) on LinkedIn for a product: start it, check its status, pause or resume. Runs in the background in small paced sessions under a daily page budget; a CSV grows as it goes. Use when the user wants many leads (e.g. '10,000 leads', 'keep collecting…'); for a quick top 10 use leads_find.

args.product: string: product link or idea (start), or words to find the list
args.daily_views: int: LinkedIn pages per day (default 100, max 120)
